# MetLife

> MetLife offers comprehensive insurance and employee benefits solutions including life, health, dental, vision, disability, and specialized coverage plans.

MetLife provides a full suite of insurance products and employee benefit solutions for individuals, families, and employers. The site features digital portals like MyBenefits, MetLink, and eSERVICE for account management and claims processing, alongside specialized offerings like identity protection through Aura partnership and legal plan services.

## Key Topics

- Life Insurance
- Health Insurance
- Dental Insurance
- Vision Insurance
- Disability Insurance
- Employee Benefits
- Group Benefits
- Critical Illness Insurance
- Accident Insurance
- Hospital Indemnity Insurance
- HSA/FSA Accounts
- Identity Protection
- Legal Plans
- MyBenefits Portal
- Total Control Account

## Core Insurance Products

- [Insurance and Employee Benefits | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com): MetLife homepage with access to life, auto, home, dental, vision insurance and employee benefits.
- [Life Insurance Solutions | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/life-insurance): MetLife life insurance solutions protecting loved ones with various coverage options.
- [Health Insurance Solutions | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/health): MetLife health insurance solutions and options for individuals and families.
- [Dental Insurance | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/dental-insurance): MetLife dental insurance product page with coverage details and provider network access.
- [Vision Insurance | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/vision-insurance): MetLife vision insurance covering eye conditions, exams, glasses and contacts.
- [Disability Insurance and Absence Management Services| MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/disability-insurance): MetLife disability insurance and absence management protecting income and financial security.

## Specialized Health & Accident Coverage

- [Accident & Health Insurance | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/accident-health): MetLife accident and health insurance solutions for employee and group benefits.
- [Critical Illness Insurance Plans | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/accident-health/critical-illness-insurance): MetLife critical illness insurance providing lump-sum payment for diagnosed conditions.
- [Accident Insurance | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/accident-health/accident-insurance): MetLife voluntary accident insurance covering financial impact of accidents.
- [Cancer Insurance | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/accident-health/cancer-insurance): MetLife cancer insurance covering out-of-pocket expenses from cancer diagnosis.
- [MetLife Hospital Indemnity Insurance | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/accident-health/hospital-indemnity-insurance): MetLife hospital indemnity insurance with guaranteed acceptance and lump-sum benefits.

## Life Insurance & Employee Benefits

- [Term Life Insurance Policies | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/life-insurance/term-life): MetLife term life insurance policies for affordable long-term family protection.
- [Group Universal Life Insurance | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/life-insurance/group-variable-universal-life-insurance): MetLife group universal life insurance for employer and employee benefits.
- [Accidental Death and Dismemberment | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/life-insurance/accidental-death-and-dismemberment): MetLife accidental death and dismemberment coverage as employee benefit.

## Financial & Legal Services

- [Health Savings & Spending Accounts | Insurance | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/hsa-fsa): MetLife HSA, FSA, and dependent care accounts for tax-advantaged healthcare savings.
- [Legal Plans | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/legal-plans): MetLife legal plans with unlimited consultations for wills, real estate, identity theft.
- [MetLife + Aura Identity and Fraud Protection | MetLife](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/identity-and-fraud-protection): MetLife and Aura identity theft and fraud protection with credit monitoring.

## Account & Benefit Management

- [What Is a MetLife Total Control Account?](https://www.metlife.com/insurance/life-insurance/learn-about-tca): MetLife Total Control Account overview for beneficiaries managing life insurance proceeds.
